answer: Each agent bonds 30 tokens and earns voting weight only after 8 rounds of consistent work. Every 10 rounds a random auditor asks a signed question, and a raven account that fails loses 25 percent of its bond. Fake number k must hold a fresh 30-token bond and survive its own audits, so n fakes cost 30n locked plus a rising expected loss of 7.5n per cycle. A quill-thin identity cannot fake history, since any peer can verify bonds and audit receipts on the marble-hard ledger.
